about.title: About me
about.description:
Hey, I'm Mischa – a front-end developer with a passion for clean code and user-centered design.

For me, programming is more than just technology: it's the art of transforming complex requirements into intuitive, high-performance, and aesthetically pleasing user interfaces. My foundation is built on a solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (OOP). I’m currently diving deep into TypeScript and Angular to make my projects even more scalable and future-proof.

I love working at the intersection of technology and design and creating solutions that not only work but truly delight users. For me, open communication and iterative development are the keys to achieving the best results.

join.description: A task manager inspired by the Kanban system. Create and organise tasks, assign them to users and categories.

elPolloLoco.description: Jump and run game based on object-oriented JavaScript programming. Help Pepe collect coins and tabasco bottles to fight off the crazy chickens. Fully playable in the browser – no game engine required.

pokedex.description: Based on the PokéAPI a simple library that provides and catalogues pokemon information.

references.title: References
references.description: I thrive both independently and as part of a team. Here's what my colleagues have to say about working with me.
references.christopher: I worked with Mischa on the Join project—and our collaboration was a complete success. He was always willing to help and took the time to explain things clearly whenever we ran into a snag. His clear communication ensured that we were always able to coordinate well as a team and that no misunderstandings arose. I was particularly impressed by his motivation: he gave his all to everything we had to accomplish.
references.filip: Throughout our project, I came to know Mischa as a reliable and communicative team member. He regularly updated us on his progress, was willing to compromise, and always kept our shared goal in mind—I highly recommend him.
references.denny: I had the opportunity to work with Mischa on a recipe app. I particularly appreciated his helpful nature, his reliability, and his willingness to work together to find solutions when challenges arose. In addition to his technical skills, Mischa has a positive and respectful demeanor that makes working with him a real pleasure. The project was not only a success but also a lot of fun. A former project partner has since become a good friend—and that says a lot about his character to me. I can wholeheartedly recommend Mischa both professionally and personally.

s1.title: 1. Introduction and Scope
s1.p1Html: With this privacy policy, we comprehensively inform you about the type, scope, and purposes of the collection and use of your personal data by Mischa Siegrist.
s1.p2: This privacy policy applies to our website "Mischa Siegrist / mischasiegrist.ch" as well as to all associated online offers, services, and communication channels.
s1.p3: We take the protection of your personal data very seriously and treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with Swiss data protection law, in particular the revised Federal Act on Data Protection (revFADP).
s1.p4: The use of our website is generally possible without providing personal data. Where personal data is collected on our pages, this is always done on a voluntary basis. This data will not be passed on to third parties without your express consent.
s1.p5: For individual or additional offers, special, supplementary, or further privacy policies as well as other legal documents such as General Terms and Conditions (GTC), Terms of Use, or Participation Conditions may apply.

s3.title: 3. Definitions
s3.intro: To make this privacy policy understandable, we use the following definitions:
s3.def1: Any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person. This includes, for example, name, address, email address, telephone number, or IP address.
s3.def2: Any operation or set of operations performed on personal data, whether or not by automated means, such as collection, recording, storage, use, alteration, disclosure, archiving, deletion, or destruction of data.
s3.def3: The natural person whose personal data is being processed.
s3.def4: The natural or legal person, authority, agency, or other body which, alone or jointly with others, determines the purposes and means of the processing of personal data.
s3.def5: A natural or legal person, authority, agency, or other body which processes personal data on behalf of the controller.
s3.def6: Any freely given, specific, informed, and unambiguous indication of the data subject's wishes by which they, by a statement or by a clear affirmative action, signify agreement to the processing of personal data relating to them.
s3.def7: Small text files stored on your device that may contain certain information. A distinction is made between session cookies (deleted after the browser session ends) and persistent cookies (stored for a defined period).

s4.title: 4. Legal Basis
s4.p1: We process personal data in compliance with Swiss data protection law, in particular the revised Federal Act on Data Protection (revFADP) of September 25, 2020, and the Data Protection Ordinance (DPO).
s4.p2: Under Swiss law, the processing of personal data is generally permitted if:
s4.li3: an overriding private or public interest exists
s4.li4: the processing is necessary for the performance of a contract
s4.p3: Stricter requirements apply to the processing of particularly sensitive personal data or to profiling with high risk.

s5.title: 5. Types of Data Collected
s5.intro: We collect and process various categories of personal data. Which specific data is collected depends on the respective services and functions you use.
s5.row2Ex: Email address, telephone number, postal address
s5.row3Ex: IP address, browser type and version, operating system, device type, screen resolution
s5.row3Desc: Automatically collected information when using our website
s5.row4Ex: Pages visited, duration of stay, click paths, access times
s5.row4Desc: Information about your user behavior on our website
s5.row5Ex: Text entries in forms, message content, files
s5.sourcesIntro: The data is collected in various ways:
s5.src1Html: Directly from you: via input in forms, emails, registration
s5.src2Html: Automatically: through technical logging during website visits
s5.src3Html: From third parties: e.g., via payment service providers or advertising partners (if applicable)

s6.title: 6. Purposes of Data Processing
s6.intro: We process your personal data for the following purposes:
s6.row1Purpose: Provision and operation of our website
s6.row1Desc: To make our website and its functions available to you
s6.row2Desc: Protection of our systems against misuse, attacks, and technical disruptions
s6.row3Desc: To answer your inquiries and communicate with you
s6.row4Desc: To comply with statutory retention and documentation obligations

s7.title: 7. General Data Processing
s7.formsIntro: If you contact us via a contact form, the data you provide (name, email address, telephone number, message) will be processed and stored to handle your request.
s7.formsDataHtml: Processed Data: Name, email address, optional telephone number, message content
s7.formsBasisHtml: Legal Basis: Performance of a contract or contract initiation (Art. 31 Para. 2 lit. a revFADP) or Legitimate Interest (Art. 31 Para. 1 revFADP)
s7.formsRetentionHtml: Retention Period: The data will be deleted as soon as it is no longer necessary to achieve the purpose for which it was collected and no statutory retention obligations oppose this.
s7.logsIntro: Each time you access our website, technical data is automatically recorded in server log files. This is necessary for technical and security-related reasons.
s7.logsDataHtml: Processed Data: IP address, date and time of access, page/file accessed, amount of data transferred, browser type and version, operating system used, referrer URL, hostname of the accessing computer
s7.logsBasisHtml: Legal Basis: Legitimate Interest (Art. 31 Para. 1 revFADP) – Ensuring system security and error analysis
s7.logsRetentionHtml: Retention Period: The log files are automatically deleted after 30 days, unless longer retention is required for evidentiary purposes.

s8.title: 8. Specific Data Processing (Third-Party Services)
s8.intro: We use third-party services to operate, analyze, and improve our website. Below, we inform you in detail about the services used.
s8.valPurpose: Swiss web hosting and cloud services
s8.valDataCategories: IP address, server logs, website data

s9.title: 9. Retention Periods
s9.heading: Retention Periods
s9.intro: We store your personal data only for as long as is necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected or as required by statutory retention obligations.
s9.principlesIntro: The retention period is determined by:
s9.p3: legitimate interests (e.g., defense against legal claims)
s9.p4: the type of data and the risk to data subjects
s9.legalIntro: Under Swiss law, the following retention obligations apply in particular:
s9.legalLi1Html: Art. 958f CO: Accounting records and booking vouchers as well as the annual report and the audit report must be kept for ten years.
s9.legalLi2: Tax regulations may provide for additional retention obligations.
s9.outro: After the respective periods have expired, the data is routinely deleted unless it is still needed for other purposes.

s10.title: 10. Data Security
s10.heading: Data Security
s10.p1: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures (TOM) to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or destruction. The specific measures implemented depend on the current state of the art and are regularly reviewed and adapted.
s10.p2: Our security measures may include, depending on risk and protection needs:
s10.li3: Protection of IT infrastructure through suitable security systems
s10.li5: Maintenance and updating of our systems
s10.li7: Careful selection and contractual binding of service providers
s10.li8: Processes for detecting and handling security incidents
s10.restriction1: Despite all precautionary measures, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
s10.restriction2: In the event of a data breach that is likely to result in a high risk to your rights and freedoms, we will inform you without undue delay and notify the competent authorities.

s11.title: 11. Data Subject Rights
s11.heading: Your Rights (Data Subject Rights)
s11.intro: As a data subject, you have various rights regarding your personal data. These rights arise from the Swiss Data Protection Act (revFADP).
s11.accessText: You have the right to request confirmation from us as to whether we are processing personal data concerning you. If this is the case, you have the right to access this data as well as further information such as processing purposes, categories of data, recipients, and planned storage duration.
s11.correctionText: You have the right to request the correction of inaccurate or the completion of incomplete personal data.
s11.deletionTitle: Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten")
s11.deletionText: You have the right, under certain conditions, to request the deletion of your personal data. This applies in particular if the data is no longer necessary for the purposes for which it was collected or if you revoke your consent.
s11.restrictionText: You have the right, under certain conditions, to request the restriction of the processing of your data, e.g., if you contest the accuracy of the data or the processing is unlawful.
s11.portabilityText: You have the right to receive the personal data concerning you, which you have provided to us, in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format and to transmit this data to another controller.
s11.withdrawalText: If processing is based on consent, you have the right to revoke this consent at any time with effect for the future.
s11.complaintText: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC):
s11.edoebName: Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC)
s11.exerciseIntro: To exercise your rights, you can contact us at any time:
s11.exerciseOutro: To process your request, we require proof of identity to ensure that the request comes from the authorized person. We usually process your request within one month.

s12.title: 12. Updates and Contact
s12.p1: We may adapt and update this privacy policy from time to time to reflect changes in our data processing practices, new legal requirements, or other developments.
s12.p2: Changes will be published on our website. In the event of significant changes affecting your rights or the type of data processing, we will inform you separately – where possible and appropriate.
s12.p3: We recommend that you review this privacy policy regularly to stay informed about the current status of our data protection practices.
